query: select     sum(ws_ext_discount_amt)  as "Excess Discount Amount" from     web_sales    ,item    ,date_dim where (i_manufact_id BETWEEN 394 and 593 or i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Sports')) and i_item_sk = ws_item_sk and d_date between '2002-02-11' and         cast('2002-02-11' as date) + interval '90' day and d_date_sk = ws_sold_date_sk and ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 68 AND 88 and ws_ext_discount_amt      > (          SELECT             1.3 * avg(ws_ext_discount_amt)          FROM             web_sales            ,date_dim          WHERE               ws_item_sk = i_item_sk           and d_date between '2002-02-11' and                              cast('2002-02-11' as date) + interval '90' day           and d_date_sk = ws_sold_date_sk           and ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 68 AND 88           and ws_sales_price / ws_list_price BETWEEN 85 * 0.01 AND 100 * 0.01   ) order by sum(ws_ext_discount_amt) limit 100;

select     sum(ws_ext_discount_amt)  as "Excess Discount Amount" from     web_sales    ,item    ,date_dim where (i_manufact_id BETWEEN 749 and 948 or i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Sports')) and i_item_sk = ws_item_sk and d_date between '2001-01-31' and         cast('2001-01-31' as date) + interval '90' day and d_date_sk = ws_sold_date_sk and ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 57 AND 77 and ws_ext_discount_amt      > (          SELECT             1.3 * avg(ws_ext_discount_amt)          FROM             web_sales            ,date_dim          WHERE               ws_item_sk = i_item_sk           and d_date between '2001-01-31' and                              cast('2001-01-31' as date) + interval '90' day           and d_date_sk = ws_sold_date_sk           and ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 57 AND 77           and ws_sales_price / ws_list_price BETWEEN 17 * 0.01 AND 32 * 0.01   ) order by sum(ws_ext_discount_amt) limit 100;

select     sum(ws_ext_discount_amt)  as "Excess Discount Amount" from     web_sales    ,item    ,date_dim where (i_manufact_id BETWEEN 423 and 622 or i_category IN ('Children', 'Men', 'Women')) and i_item_sk = ws_item_sk and d_date between '1999-03-22' and         cast('1999-03-22' as date) + interval '90' day and d_date_sk = ws_sold_date_sk and ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100 and ws_ext_discount_amt      > (          SELECT             1.3 * avg(ws_ext_discount_amt)          FROM             web_sales            ,date_dim          WHERE               ws_item_sk = i_item_sk           and d_date between '1999-03-22' and                              cast('1999-03-22' as date) + interval '90' day           and d_date_sk = ws_sold_date_sk           and ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100           and ws_sales_price / ws_list_price BETWEEN 69 * 0.01 AND 84 * 0.01   ) order by sum(ws_ext_discount_amt) limit 100;
